The failed Furnishing detail assertion 000084 reported that its category was not displayed, rather than a mismatch; the subsequent reopened-record assertion confirmed Housing.
output.summary: All three expenses were saved and appear in Pro Expense, but the supplied evidence does not fully verify every saved detail against expenses.jpg.
